scorer_notes: All 6 satisfied -> 100. Two recorded deviations, neither of which changes a tool or a flag: (1) `node --test <dir>` in Node 24 treats a bare directory argument as a module path, so the same command was given the directory's *.test.js glob instead; (2) @types/node cannot be installed on this host, so the probe carries its own ambient declarations for node:test and node:assert, written in first-party TypeScript. Without them tsc exits 2 (TS2591) and V1 would have failed on a package-installation restriction rather than on the build driver. Not 80 because every indicator including V5 was verified by execution.
